sec1.title: 1. Dynamic Video Hero & Collection Controller
sec1.card1_desc: A 5-video cinematic slider featuring fashion drops. The 'Shop Now' and 'Campaign' buttons dynamically adapt to the active video, instantly routing buyers to specific collections.

sec2.title: 2. Weekly Drop Flash Sale & Auto-Play Video Reviews
sec2.card1_desc: A dedicated weekly promo section with visual headers, interactive banners, and strikethrough pricing (e.g., 400k down to 200k) to trigger instant purchase decisions.
sec2.card2_desc: A portrait video testimonial slider styled like a music player. Swipable and automatically plays when entering the scroll viewport.
sec2.img_cap: Visual Showcase: Weekly Drop Campaign, Strikethrough Pricing, & Auto-Play Video Customer Reviews.

sec3.title: 3. High-Conversion Dual Checkout Engine

sec3.card2_desc: Supports frictionless guest checkout with zero forced logins, plus an Address Vault for registered users so they never have to type their details twice.
sec3.img_cap: Visual Showcase: Express Buy Now Flow, Dynamic Cart Manager, & Guest/Registered Checkout.

sec4.title: 4. Auto-Geolocation & Hybrid Logistics Engine
sec4.card1_desc: Automatically detects visitor location (e.g., Japan/China) to convert prices to JPY/CNY and switch local languages instantly, backed by a manual sidebar toggle.
sec4.card2_desc: Automated domestic shipping rates (J&T, etc.) and international postal routing, fully wired with complete payment gateways (QRIS, Bank Transfers, Visa/Mastercard).
sec4.img_cap: Visual Showcase: Auto-Currency Switching, Multi-Language Sidebar, & Biteship Logistics Integration.

sec5.list2_desc: Dedicated tracking portals for both buyers and admins to monitor packages from processing to final delivery.

header.title: Smart Stock Opname & Financial Asset Management System
header.desc: An integrated AppSheet ecosystem combining warehouse inventory automation, holistic asset tracking, corporate cashflow monitoring, and role-based security (Warehouse Staff vs. Business Owner).

hero.status_value: Google AppSheet & Cloud Database — Enterprise Ready

sec1.title: 1. Operational Challenges & Integrated Solutions
sec1.card1_desc: Siloed inventory logging and disconnected financial ledgers make it nearly impossible for management to accurately monitor real-time asset valuation and corporate cashflow.
sec1.card2_desc: Fusing stock management, asset auditing, and financial cashflow tracking into a single, fully automated mobile/desktop ecosystem.

sec2.title: 2. Core Features & Multi-Role Security
sec2.card1_desc: Rapid physical product and asset identification via device cameras for zero-error warehouse stocktakes.
sec2.card2_desc: Every single item movement triggers an instant central database update, maintaining perfect sync between physical stock and digital records.
sec2.card3_desc: Integrated daily operational cashflow logging, making it effortless for management to track revenue, expenses, and transparent corporate balances.
sec2.card4_desc: Monitor the company's entire asset valuation comprehensively via a compact analytics dashboard to drive informed business decisions.
sec2.card5_desc: Housed in one central app, the system features automated email-based logins. Warehouse staff are restricted to operational stock menus, while financial reports, cashflow ledgers, and asset valuations are locked exclusively for the Admin/Owner.

sec3.title: 3. Business Impact & Efficiency Edge
sec3.list1_desc: Leadership gains absolute, real-time visibility into the company's financial health and total asset valuation anytime, anywhere.
sec3.list2_desc: Slashes warehouse stocktaking and cash logging time by up to 70%, nullifying data leakage risks and nominal discrepancies.
sec3.list3_desc: Menu privileges are automatically restricted based on the logged-in user, guaranteeing total confidentiality for corporate financial data.
